authority: PI, 2026-09-04, raised BEFORE any OTD result exists and while round-1 collection was still running. Explicit instruction: do not secretly change the running experiment -- keep OTD exactly as frozen -- but constrain what a FAIL is allowed to conclude.
rule: APPEND, not an edit. No protocol, seed, horizon, gate, or running job changes. This record narrows the permitted READING of a FAIL and corrects one overstated sentence in the parent spec.

THE_OVERSTATED_SENTENCE.parent_spec_says: 'the collected states ARE the deployment distribution'
THE_OVERSTATED_SENTENCE.correction: they are the CPU deployment distribution. The sealed eval is scored on CUDA (per ONPOLICY_TD_DEVICE_AMENDMENT.json, because the device A/B showed device-dependent trajectories). Collection and measurement therefore run on numerically different instruments.
THE_OVERSTATED_SENTENCE.already_true_of_round_0: the offline TD teacher-state collection was also CPU while COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json was scored on CUDA. This is a standing property of the program, not a new defect introduced here.

NEW_EVIDENCE_THE_DEVICE_EFFECT_LOOKS_SYS.source: the same controlled A/B recorded in ONPOLICY_TD_DEVICE_AMENDMENT.json (identical policy, identical 8 seeds, identical env, forced z0, Pole A -- device is the only variable)
NEW_EVIDENCE_THE_DEVICE_EFFECT_LOOKS_SYS.reading: blue scores roughly twice as much on CPU. This is a DIRECTIONAL, systematic-looking difference, not merely two equivalent random draws from one distribution. n=8, one cell only, so it is suggestive rather than established -- but it is strong enough that the CPU-collected DAgger distribution cannot be assumed interchangeable with the CUDA-scored one.
NEW_EVIDENCE_THE_DEVICE_EFFECT_LOOKS_SYS.consistent_observation_not_a_controlled_: round-1 collection (CPU) reports z0@A win rate 0.750, while the sealed CUDA eval measured that same cell at 0.5469. Different seed blocks, so this is confounded and is NOT evidence on its own -- recorded only because its direction matches the controlled A/B.

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_INVALIDATE.the_gate_arithmetic: the crossover gate is a WITHIN-pole difference (z0 vs z1, both scored on the same device, same seeds, same episodes). A uniform device-induced level shift largely cancels in delta_A and delta_B. COMPRESSION_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json and any OTD seal remain internally valid measurements.
WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_INVALIDATE.the_concern_is_narrower: it is specifically that DAgger's TRAINING distribution (CPU student states) may not match the distribution the seal SCORES (CUDA student states). That is a threat to the covariate-shift hypothesis test, not to the gate's arithmetic.

CONSTRAINED_READING_OF_A_FAIL.permitted: OTD FAIL => covariate-shift correction was insufficient UNDER THIS PROTOCOL (CPU-collected student states, CUDA-scored seal).
CONSTRAINED_READING_OF_A_FAIL.NOT_permitted_on_a_FAIL_alone: OTD FAIL => the parameter-sharing architecture is definitely at fault. The parent spec's two FAIL rows both nominate the sharing ladder as successor; that nomination is hereby demoted from a conclusion to a CANDIDATE successor.
what_would_license_the_architecture_conc: on-policy fidelity rising materially across rounds AND approaching the teacher-state holdout level (~0.96/0.98) on the student's own states, while crossover still fails -- i.e. direct evidence that imitation error on the deployment distribution is no longer the binding constraint; even then the CPU/CUDA distribution gap remains a stated caveat, OR

a device-matched replication: collect student states on CUDA (the measurement instrument) and repeat. Slower (~3.3x per episode) but methodologically clean. This is the FIRST successor to consider on a FAIL, ahead of the sharing ladder, precisely because it removes the confound rather than assuming past it.
CONSTRAINED_READING_OF_A_FAIL.on_a_PASS: unchanged and if anything strengthened: student-state augmentation recovered crossover despite generalising across a device-induced trajectory difference.

THE_NEXT_INFORMATIVE_NUMBER_UNCHANGED: the preregistered 'red-handed' diagnostic -- the offline TD student's teacher-agreement on its OWN round-1 states, versus its 0.965/0.984 on teacher-visited states. A substantial drop is direct evidence the offline fidelity numbers were hiding deployment-distribution error. It remains a DIAGNOSTIC; crossover remains the only scientific gate.
